integrity: The missing mixed facet is proved independently by a weighted server-capacity certificate for every \(m\ge3\), and exact achievability of the corrected polytope follows from the 2020 theorem after an explicit row and column permutation. The \(m=3\) case is also exhaustively reconstructed from all recovery sets.
scientific_limitations: The claim corrects the full service-rate-region statement in version 1 of the October 2026 preprint. The exact corrected region was already proved for an equivalent non-systematic first-order Reed--Muller generator in 2020; the new contribution is the source-specific conflict diagnosis and uniform infeasible family. A later source revision may incorporate the repair.
title: A missing mixed-demand facet in the 2026 Plotkin Reed–Muller service-rate region
